programs.title: National Treasures · The Mystery of the Bronze Tiger
programs.desc: In 1978, a number of engraved bronze vessels were unearthed, dating back sometime between the 3-6th centuries. Each fascinating in their own right, one resembling a tiger with a gaping, circular mouth was of particular interest. Learn more about its discovery, significance and why it is now classified as a Grade One National Cultural Relic.

programs.title: Hermit Master Ep.5
programs.desc: This documentary tracks a three-year journey spanning tens of thousands of kilometers. Adopting a rational and scientific perspective, it interprets the origins of traditional Chinese martial arts and reveals the little-known inheritance and secrets of kung fu.

programs.title: Kung Fu Wise II Ep.1
programs.desc: Host Kleber explores the origins and evolution of martial arts, witnessing how ancient traditions take root in contemporary life. This season reveals the practical side of martial arts — hard and soft techniques — while also examining the spiritual: self-cultivation and cross-cultural dialogue.
